title: names
summary: MSUI implements the ask-once name discipline for the two main paths: player names by guid (CMSG_NAME_QUERY, _queriedPlayerNames dedupe set) and creature records by template entry (CMSG_CREATURE_QUERY with the full 5875 response decoded - name, subname, type flags, creature type, rank, civilian, racial leader - and the high-bit negative cached in _creatureQueryRecords). The unanswered-ask set is cleared on zoning so a dropped query is re-askable, matching Benilla's clear_pending.

openItems.text: The pet naming path is absent: CMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY / SMSG_PET_NAME_QUERY_RESPONSE are not implemented, so a summoned pet (guid carrying a pet number, not a template entry) can never resolve a name
SMSG_NAME_QUERY_RESPONSE's race/class/gender triple is discarded (only the name is kept), so the $R/$C/$G macro fallback for un-streamed players has no data source
